tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs:

rgya gar skad du: yak+ṣa rat+na dhe ba: sarba no pi ka nā ma: bod skad du: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas gsang ba'i bdag po yis: 'di skad ces gsol to: kye ston pa kun bzang he ru ka: sgrub pa'i yo byad phun tshogs phyir: 'dod yon nor sgrub yongs rdzogs gang: de skad ces gsol bka' bstsal pa: 'byor pa'i longs spyod spel ba'i phyir: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs bshad: nor bdag ded dpon gnod sbyin yin: gnod sbyin bye brag bsam yas kyang: nyer 'dus pho dgu mo dgu yin: gtso bo dzam la gcig pur 'dus: sgrub lugs spyi chings nying khol las: spyi chings gnod sbyin srog 'khor te: mthing shog dag la rin chen lngas: pad 'khor pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri: mu khyud lngas bskor lte dbus su: hūm̐ dzaṃ bha la pā shang hring: sngags pa che ge la puṇ+ye ye: sarba sid+dhi sdus sdus: de'i phyi lte ba'i mu khyud bar: dzaṃ dgu baṃ dgu spel mas bskor: 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi nang brgyad du: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā: rtsibs mchan pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇī swā hā: mu khyud nang mar yak+ṣa brgyad: sid+dhi hūm̐ dang spel mar bri: de'i phyi las mkhan srog sngags bri: oṃ tri'u tri'u myur shog: ya tri drung drung tri ā yu puṇ+ye sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ ā: de'i phyi lcags kyu kha sprod brgyad: bar du 'dod yon ming spel bri: legs bris gur gum dri bzang byug: a ru rma med gser mdog la: gser gyi dzaṃ baṃ tri bris te: de nyid 'khor lo'i dbus su ni: dar snas dril te dkar gsum dang: mngar gsum 'bru sna lngar bcas pa: zangs sam gwa'u'i kham phor gzhug: yongs rdzogs rtsa ba'i snying po la: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya swā hā: oṃ bā su dhā ri ṇī swā hā: sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ ā:

de dag stong bzlas rab gnas bya: de nyid bcangs pas gnod sbyin rnams: bsdus nas nor gyi char pa 'beb: de nas gnod sbyin thams cad kyi: nor gyi las mkhan nying khol bsgrub: g.ya' mtshams dben par phyin nas kyang: maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byas pa'i steng: srin bya'i sha yis brgyan pa yi: brda gtor gcig bshams ras dkar la: byis pa'i gzugs legs rgyan can bri: mda' bzang rgod sgro can la btags: gzhan yang ras khug gtsang ma'i nang: pha wang long bu shel bye ru: gser sbram dril te rten du bzung: rang nyid lhar gsal zhag gsum du: srog gi snying po 'dis 'gugs bya: oṃ tri'u tri'u myur shog: ya tri drung drung tri: mi tshig spangs te bzlas brtson na: nangs mo ltas 'khrugs de rjes dag: tha ma byis pa mang pos bskor: de tshe nor 'gugs sham bur btags: sid+dhi sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐: dngos su ci 'byor nor rnams ster: mig mthong 'dod na sngags 'di bzlas: tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥphye swā hā: de yis mngon shes 'jig rten ston: dbang bsod 'dod na sngags 'di bzlas: sarba pā shaṃ ku ru swā hā: de yang sbrags sgrub 'di kho na: rgyun du bsgrubs pas bsam tshad 'grub: sid+dhi tsak+ṣuḥpā shaṃ sa ma ye swā hā: dngos grub myur 'byung rgyun du bzlas: zhag gsum rjes la zas gtor byin: gter mdzod gnyer kha 'bab pa dang: byis pas phyag 'tshal lo thog brnga: bzang rtags de yin kho khros na: mi nag mdze phos rtsod cing rgol: rgyan stor sprang po nor 'dod 'ong: dgongs pa spar zhing nyams pa bshags: gtor ma gtong zhing dbang du bsdus: tshe dbang bu nor bdag por 'gyur: ces bka' bstsal to: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sgrub thabs 'dir sprul pa'i dzam bha la rigs bco lnga yab yum sras 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'o:1$0000250 ༄༅: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi 'phrin las bzhugs:1$0000300

rgya gar skad du: yak+ṣa rad na dhe wa sarba karma nā ma: bod skad du: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las zhes bya ba: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par: maṇ+ḍal mchod gtor phun sum tshogs pa bshams la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab: de nas rang nyid lhar gsal bas: hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings: kun la khyab pa thugs rje'i mchog: rang sems cho 'phrul dzaṃ du shar: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na sa mā ti oṃ: dharma dhā tu sa mā ti hūm̐: badz+ra tsit+ta sa mā ti hūm̐: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ: maṇ+ḍa la: hūm̐: dbang chen rigs lnga brtsegs pa'i steng: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: phyi rol 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra: bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar: dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la: pad+ma nyi ma zla ba dang: gter gyi bum pa'i khri steng du: hūm̐ las mgon po dzaṃ bha la: mthing nag thod khrag ne'u le bsnams: de yi phyi rim pad 'dab bzhi: de steng pad+ma zla ba'i gdan: dzaṃ yig rigs bzhi'i 'phro 'dus las: shar du 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la: dkar po bgrang phreng ne'u le bsnams: lho ru yon tan dzaṃ bha la: gser mdog nor bu shing tog bsnams: nub tu gsung mchog dzaṃ bha la: dmar po nor bu ne'u le bsnams: byang du phrin las dzaṃ bha la: ljang gu rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams: de yi phyi rim pad 'khor brgyad: de steng pad+ma zla ba'i steng: dzaṃ brgyad baṃ brgyad 'phro 'dus las: gang bzang la sogs yab brgyad dang: nor rgyun la sogs yum brgyad ni: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: nor bu dang ni ne'u le 'dzin: kun kyang sku mdog gser gyi mdog: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs kyi: nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: de yi phyi rim gru chad la:

gnod sbyin a par tsi ta ni: dkar po phyag gnyis bum pa bsnams: pus btsugs bum pa'i gdan la bzhugs: las mkhan tri 'u dam tshig can: byis pa gzhon nu'i cha lugs can: phyag na snying dang zhags pa bsnams: bar khyams gnod sbyin bye ba gnas: sgo bzhi sgo ma bzhi yis srung: de rnams kun gyi gnas gsum du: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: ye shes lnga ru byin gyis brlabs: de nas dad pas spyan drangs pa: hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i pho brang nas: longs spyod rin chen sna bzhi'i gzhal yas nas: dgos 'dod dngos grub sna tshogs blang ba'i phyir: mgon po chu dbang 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya hrīng hrīngaḥdzaḥdza: hūm̐: gnod sbyin ded dpon mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso: khyed kyis sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la: sgrub mchog bdag cag re ba bskang ba'i phyir: yid 'ong gnas 'dir dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: sa ma ya: ā be sha ya a ā: hūm̐: gnod sbyin ded dpon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: nyi zla ltar brjid rin chen 'bar ba'i sku: dngos grub sna tshogs zad med mnga' mdzad pa: gter skyong 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta bha ling rgyan: rin chen sna bdun bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pū tsa khā hi: a la la ho: de nas snying po bzla ba ni: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya: bā su dhā ri ṇī swā hā: bye ba thems nas dngos grub blang: sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ ā: de nas rgyun du ci nus bzlas: dngos grub thob par the tshom med: sgrub pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni:

hūm̐: dngos grub char 'beb rin chen lta bu'i sku: nam mkha'i mdog can thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: sku mchog 'gro don mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: yid bzhin rin chen gter gyi char 'beb cing: gangs ri'i mdog can bgrang phreng ne'u le bsnams: dbul phongs sdug bsngal skyob par zhal bzhes pa'i: thugs rjes nyam thag skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam shing lta bu: gser gyi mdog can shing thog ne'u le bsnams: ut+pal sngon po'i phreng bas sku la brgyan: yon tan longs spyod rgyas la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bsam 'grub re skong nor bu bsam 'phel ltar: dmar gsal rab brjid nor bu ne'u le 'dzin: yid bzhin nor bu'i dngos grub char ltar 'beb: thams cad dbang sdud pad+ma'i gsung la bstod: hūm̐: phrin las lhun grub dngos grub kun gyi mdzod: in+d+ra'i mdog can rgyal mtshan ne'u le bsnams: gang 'dul der ston thabs kyis 'gro don mdzad: phrin las 'gro ba 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sku yi sprul pa gang bzang dpal dang ldan: gsung gi sprul pa nor bzang tshangs pa'i gsung: thugs kyi sprul pa gnod sbyin rig par ldan: phrin las sprul pa rnam thos drag rtsal ldan: zhi ba'i las mdzad pra sna pra dug can: rgyas pa'i las mdzad bzhad gdang phreng ba can: dbang gi las mdzad kha yi dbang po can: drag po'i las mdzad dbang po mchog spyod pa: rin chen gter 'chang dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i mchog: bka' yi bstan skyong dngos grub mchog rnams stsol: mgon po gnod sbyin brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgos 'dod nor gyi char 'beb nor rgyun ma: shes rab rnam dag ldan pa'i zla 'od ma: dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i sbyin mar grags: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rab ldan rab sbyin ma: 'khor ba'i sa la skyon bral 'phags mar grags:

las rab don grub rab tu bzang mo'i sku: chos nyid gter 'chang sbas ma'i ngang nyid las: mdzes ma'i skur ston lha mo rab tu gsal: tshangs pa'i gsung mnga' lha mo dbyangs can ma: rin chen rgyan spras mnyes mdzad lha mo brgyad: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gtso bo'i thugs dam bskul: mkha' dbyings shes rab yum gyi ngang tshul can: nor gter lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod: gter bdag chen po a par tsi ta dang: myur mgyogs las mkhan tri'u thugs dam can: gnod sbyin las mkhan bye ba sa ya'i tshogs: sgo bzhi srung mdzad nor gter lha mo bzhi: kun kyang phyag gnyis nor bu ne'u le bsnams: nor lha yongs rdzogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dir byon phul ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: gnod sbyin gter skyong 'khor dang bcas rnams ni: sems can don mdzad byang chub sems dang ldan: dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing lta bu: yid bzhin rin chen lta bu'i dngos grub stsol: 'gyur med sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'gag med gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'khrul med thugs kyi dngos grub= yon tan re skong dngos grub= 'phrin las 'gro 'dul dngos grub= 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub= zad med nor gyi dngos grub= 'bral med grogs kyi dngos grub= brgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub= theg chen chos kyi dngos grub= rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub= 'du ba gsum ldan 'khor gyi dngos grub= sbyin pa'i khrims ldan rta yi dngos grub= na bza' gdan dang gos kyi dngos grub= rkang 'gros mi nor phyugs kyi dngos grub= rin chen gser dngul zangs lcags dngos grub= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐: dngos grub bstsal dang stsol bar mi dmigs kyang: bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs dang:

sbyor lam tshogs lam gnas pa'i rig 'dzin dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje dang: 'phags pa 'khor bcas sngon gyi zhal bzhes ltar: sgrub mchog bdag la sngon gyi smon lam mthus: tshe dang chos dang las bzhi lhun grub dang: rkang mgyogs mig sman ril bu mkha' spyod dang: srid nor zas sogs mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: ces dngos grub ci 'dod zhu 'o: de nas ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya ba ni: dzaṃ: gnod sbyin gter skyong 'khor bcas rnams: 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu: 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang: nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang: mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ces brtan par bzhugs shing gshegs gsol byar mi rung ngo: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: 'phags pa 'khor bcas 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la 'khod par shog: nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing: gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje: byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzaṃ bha la: dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad pa'i bkra shis shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs: rjes kyi bya ba kun bya'o: gnod sbyin nor lha yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zang zang lha brag gi rked/ bse sgrom smug po'i dbus nas/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250༄༅: nor bdag las mkhan yod: 1$0000300dzaṃ bha la la phyag 'tshal lo: yon tan mkhan po phrin las kyi 'gro don chung na 'di ltar bya'o: shog bu la dzaṃ bha la dmar po: phyag g.yas rin po che: phyag g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa bri: de yi 'og tu a par tsi ta sku mdog dkar po dar sngon gyi gos gyon pa: g.yas lcags kyu g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa bri: de'i zhabs 'og tu the'u rang las mkhan gsum gyi gzugs: lag na snying dang zhags pa thogs pa bri: de maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du nas bre gang la gzugs rnams btsugs la bzhag go:

de nas sngags 'di zhag bdun bzla 'o: oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya hrī: a par tsi ta dzaḥdzaḥtri'u tri'u gha na sid+dhi tri'u yon tan mkhan po myur du 'tshol du thong: pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes btags la bzla 'o: de nas zhing lpags kyis gtum la phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin la btags: dus bzhir rkang pa g.yon pa'i mtheb 'og tu bcug la sngags brgya rtsa bzla 'o: nan tan g.yeng ba che na 'phro bcad la bzhag go: yon tan mkhan po'i bogs 'don no: nor bdag gsang ba gsum sgril gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku rig 'dzin dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyi gter ma'o// mnga' ris rig 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje yis/ bdag 'dra ā nan+ta bha dra badz+ra gyis yid dad pa'i sgo nas zhu ba nan gyis phul ba la brten/ pha rin po che'i bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000250༄༅: yum nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so: 1$0000300rgya gar skad du: ār+ya bā su dhā ri no pi ka nā ma: bod skad du: 'phags ma nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba: 'phags ma nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo: 'di nyid sgrub par 'dod pa yis: dben pa'i gnas su yo byad sogs: mchod gtor bshams shing sngon 'gro bya: dkon mchog mchod cing sbyin pa gtang:

rang nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i: mdun du baṃ gyi yi ge las: nor rgyun lha mo shin tu ser: phyag na gnod sbyin 'bras snye ma: rdo rje skyil krung sbyor ba yis: spyan mdangs zhal 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: dbu la rin chen 'byung ldan bzhugs: gnod sbyin rgyal mo gsal bar bsgom: ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim: mchod bstod byas te gzungs sngags bzla: oṃ bā su swā hā: oṃ bā su shrī ye swā hā: oṃ shrī bā su ye swā hā: oṃ bā su dhā ri swā hā: oṃ bā su dhā ri: ma hā bā su shrī ti ni pa ta ni: bā su swā hā: ci nus dag cing gsal bar bzlas: sgrub yun bsrings la bsgrub par bya: zas nor shin tu rgyas par 'ong: baṃ: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs kyis: nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa: yid bzhin gter 'chang lha mo'i sku: dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod: skabs su gtor ma phul la gsol ba btab: kun la byams dang snying rje yis: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: ser sna'i las sgrib kun byang nas: sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs 'gyur: bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya: lha mo nor rgyun sgrub thabs 'di: zang zang lha brag rked la sbas: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dge'o/// /
